title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
summary: On Thursday, Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act into law, requiring disclosures on AI-generated ads. The law requires any ad - whether it's a still image, video, audio, or text - that "has been significantly modified or generated by artificial intelligence" to include a label in the same format as […]
llm_summary: Pennsylvania just enacted the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act, mandating that any ad—whether image, video, audio, or text—that’s been significantly altered or created by AI must carry a clear disclosure label. The label must appear in the same format as the rest of the ad, ensuring viewers know when AI was used. Governor Josh Shapiro signed the measure into law on Thursday, making Pennsylvania the first state to require such AI‑generated advertising
